text: This gorgeous non-leaded crystal vase features varying shades of charcoal .... This gorgeous non-leaded crystal vase features varying shades of charcoal, amethyst, pearl, and clear and reminds me of an agate. Standing nearly a foot high, the dramatic swirls and graceful lines make a striking centerpiece for your table or entryway. I own numerous Lenox place settings, but this is my first experience with one of their vases. I'd been looking for something large enough to accommodate larger bouquets, and this fit the bill perfectly.

product_metadata.title: Lenox Novia Large Vase
description: From deep charcoal to shimmering pearl, shades of swirling grey decorate the non-lead crystal novia 11 inch vase. A perfect centerpiece or design accent, with or without flowers, this elegant and stately vase is easy to coordinate with any decor. Makes a wonderful wedding or housewarming gift
